labels: Tense — the exchange is heating up.
Angry — the exchange is close to breaking down.
Furious — the exchange has broken down.

story.title: Story Mode
story.confirmReset: Reset your story progress? This cannot be undone.
story.confirmRestart: Restart this chapter from the beginning?
story.levelComplete: Level complete — {level} cleared. Practice, Discovery, Community and Extras are open from the tabs above.

discovery.title: Discovery mode
discovery.speaker: Lessons
discovery.intro: Lessons, videos and articles that deepen your understanding of Verbal Aikido. Finish a lesson quiz to mark it complete; new lessons unlock as you complete Story-mode chapters.
discovery.reqFallback: Keep playing Story mode to unlock.
discovery.resultPassed: You answered {score} of {total} correctly. Quiz passed — this lesson is now marked complete (proficiency validated).
discovery.resultFailed: You answered {score} of {total} correctly. You need at least {needed} of {total} to pass. Review the lesson and try again.

practice.title: Practice mode
practice.speaker: Dojo activities
practice.intro: Three dojo activities: centering recordings, stretching exercises, and sparring with the attack bot.
practice.cardCenteringDesc: Audio/video guided centering recordings — rate, favorite, filter by style.
practice.cardStretchDesc: Posture 1 (expression, bot-guided) and Posture 2 (listening, with a partner).
practice.cardSparDesc: The bot throws random attacks — build reflexes by choosing your response.

stretching.title: Stretching Activities
stretching.speaker: Verbal stretching
stretching.posture1Note: Expression practice builds the reflex of articulating before reacting.
stretching.posture2Note: Listening practice builds the reflex of hearing the need under the attack.

sparring.title: Sparring Activities
sparring.speaker: Attack bot
sparring.gateWarn: Validate basic knowledge first: complete the quiz for "{title}" in Discovery mode.
sparring.selfAssess: Self-assess: which response type would your reply be?
sparring.winText: Clean energy shift! That attack is redirected. {tip}
sparring.escalateText: That would escalate the exchange ({type}). Tip: {tip}

community.title: Community
community.speaker: Practitioners
community.intro: Forums, events and Find a Practitioner.
community.cardForumDesc: Post attacks, advice requests and insights — plus the pinned support thread.
community.cardEventsDesc: Online and in-person VA events — filter by format, price, belt and theme.
community.cardPractitionersDesc: Practice partners by language and availability. Adults only.

events.title: Events
events.speaker: VA events
events.intro: Online and in-person Verbal Aikido events.

practitioners.title: Find a Practitioner
practitioners.speaker: Practice partners
practitioners.intro: Pick a practice language and find a partner for centering, stretching or sparring.
practitioners.gateText: Find a Practitioner is for adults only — one-on-one practice matching is not offered to minors. Enter your date of birth to continue. This check uses the date you enter; it is not identity verification.
practitioners.dobInvalid: Please enter a valid date of birth.
practitioners.ageLocked: A date of birth under {age} was entered on this device, so it can't be changed here.
practitioners.minorText: One-on-one practitioner matching isn't available to players under {age}. You can still use the guided Practice activities and browse Events.
practitioners.requestNote: Session requests and in-person Sensei/dojo search need member accounts, which aren't built yet. The practitioners listed are sample profiles for this prototype.

extras.title: Extras
extras.speaker: Multimedia, tips & store
extras.intro: Multimedia library, practical tips and activities, and the VA Store.

profile.title: Profile
profile.speaker: {avatar} {belt} belt
profile.intro: Your belt is earned through Story chapters, Discovery quizzes, stretching sessions and sparring.
profile.ageUnverified: No date of birth given yet — needed before using Find a Practitioner.
profile.ageMinor: Age {age} — one-on-one matching isn't available under {minorAge}.
profile.ageNote: Used only for the Find a Practitioner age check. Stored on this device only. Resetting progress does not clear it.
